title: Polymarket Cross-Platform Arbitrage Detector
description: Compares Polymarket prediction market prices against PredictIt and Kalshi for the same or equivalent events. When Polymarket prices diverge significantly from other platforms, it signals a mispricing opportunity. This is the closest thing to guaranteed money in prediction markets - systematically bet the cheaper side across platforms.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone

GAMMA = 'https://gamma-api.polymarket.com'
PREDICTIT = 'https://www.predictit.org/api/marketdata/all'

now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

# H-MI-2 (2026-04-21): round-trip execution cost model.
#   * Polymarket  ~2% taker per leg
#   * PredictIt   ~10% per side (regulated; includes 5% profit fee +
#                  5% withdrawal fee averaged)
#   * SLIPPAGE    ~1% for a 2-legged cross-platform fill
# The two branches below use different totals:
#   - Poly vs PredictIt: FEE_ROUNDTRIP_POLY_PI = 13%
#   - Polymarket internal multi-outcome (both legs on Polymarket):
#     FEE_ROUNDTRIP_POLY_INTERNAL = 5%
FEE_FRACTION_POLYMARKET = 0.02
FEE_FRACTION_PREDICTIT = 0.10
SLIPPAGE = 0.01
FEE_ROUNDTRIP_POLY_PI = FEE_FRACTION_POLYMARKET + FEE_FRACTION_PREDICTIT + SLIPPAGE
FEE_ROUNDTRIP_POLY_INTERNAL = 2 * FEE_FRACTION_POLYMARKET + SLIPPAGE

rows = []

# ---- Fetch Polymarket active markets ----
poly_markets = []
for page in range(3):
    resp = requests.get(
        f'{GAMMA}/markets',
        params={'limit': 100, 'offset': page * 100, 'active': 'true', 'closed': 'false', 'order': 'volume', 'ascending': 'false'},
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    batch = resp.json()
    if not batch:
        break
    poly_markets.extend(batch)

# Build lookup of Polymarket questions -> prices
poly_lookup = {}
for m in poly_markets:
    q = m.get('question', '').strip()
    prices = m.get('outcomePrices', '[]')
    if isinstance(prices, str):
        prices = json.loads(prices)
    if prices:
        yes_price = float(prices[0])
        volume = float(m.get('volume', 0) or 0)
        liquidity = float(m.get('liquidityNum', 0) or 0)
        poly_lookup[q] = {
            'yes_price': yes_price,
            'volume': volume,
            'liquidity': liquidity,
            'slug': m.get('slug', ''),
            'condition_id': m.get('conditionId', ''),
        }

# ---- Fetch PredictIt markets ----
try:
    pi_resp = requests.get(PREDICTIT, timeout=30)
    pi_resp.raise_for_status()
    pi_data = pi_resp.json()
    pi_markets = pi_data.get('markets', [])
except Exception:
    pi_markets = []

# Build lookup of PredictIt questions -> prices
pi_lookup = {}
for pm in pi_markets:
    name = pm.get('name', '').strip()
    contracts = pm.get('contracts', [])
    for c in contracts:
        cname = c.get('name', '').strip()
        last_price = c.get('lastTradePrice', None)
        best_yes = c.get('bestBuyYesCost', None)
        best_no = c.get('bestBuyNoCost', None)
        price = last_price or best_yes
        if price is not None:
            key = f"{name} - {cname}" if len(contracts) > 1 else name
            pi_lookup[key] = {
                'yes_price': float(price),
                'best_yes': float(best_yes) if best_yes else None,
                'best_no': float(best_no) if best_no else None,
                'pi_market_name': name,
            }

# ---- Fuzzy match and compare (inlined, no function defs) ----
MIN_SIM = 0.45
MIN_DIVERGENCE = 0.05

for poly_q in poly_lookup:
    poly_data = poly_lookup[poly_q]
    best_match_q = None
    best_match_data = None
    best_sim = 0.0
    # Compute Polymarket question word set
    poly_norm = set(re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\s]', '', poly_q.lower()).split())
    for pi_q in pi_lookup:
        pi_data = pi_lookup[pi_q]
        # Compute PredictIt question word set and Jaccard similarity
        pi_norm = set(re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\s]', '', pi_q.lower()).split())
        if not poly_norm or not pi_norm:
            continue
        intersection = poly_norm & pi_norm
        union = poly_norm | pi_norm
        sim = len(intersection) / len(union)
        if sim > best_sim:
            best_sim = sim
            best_match_q = pi_q
            best_match_data = pi_data
    if best_match_q and best_sim >= MIN_SIM:
        poly_yes = poly_data['yes_price']
        pi_yes = best_match_data['yes_price']
        divergence = poly_yes - pi_yes
        abs_div = abs(divergence)
        # H-MI-2: PredictIt carries heavy fees; most 5% "arbs" are loss-making.
        net_edge = abs_div - FEE_ROUNDTRIP_POLY_PI
        net_edge_pct = round(net_edge * 100, 2)
        if abs_div >= MIN_DIVERGENCE and net_edge >= 0.01:
            if divergence > 0:
                action = f"BUY YES on PredictIt ({pi_yes:.3f}), SELL YES on Polymarket ({poly_yes:.3f})"
            else:
                action = f"BUY YES on Polymarket ({poly_yes:.3f}), SELL YES on PredictIt ({pi_yes:.3f})"
            rows.append({
                'polymarket_question': poly_q,
                'polymarket_slug': poly_data['slug'],
                'polymarket_yes_price': poly_yes,
                'polymarket_volume': poly_data['volume'],
                'polymarket_liquidity': poly_data['liquidity'],
                'predictit_question': best_match_q,
                'predictit_yes_price': pi_yes,
                'predictit_best_yes': best_match_data.get('best_yes'),
                'predictit_best_no': best_match_data.get('best_no'),
                'price_divergence': round(divergence, 4),
                'abs_divergence': round(abs_div, 4),
                'divergence_pct': round(abs_div * 100, 2),
                'fee_roundtrip_pct': round(FEE_ROUNDTRIP_POLY_PI * 100, 2),
                'net_edge_pct': net_edge_pct,
                'match_similarity': round(best_sim, 3),
                'suggested_action': action,
                'source_comparison': 'polymarket_vs_predictit',
                '_epoch': now_epoch,
            })

# ---- Internal multi-outcome consistency check ----
for page in range(2):
    resp = requests.get(
        f'{GAMMA}/events',
        params={'limit': 50, 'offset': page * 50, 'active': 'true', 'closed': 'false'},
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    events = resp.json()
    if not events:
        break
    for ev in events:
        mkts = ev.get('markets', [])
        if len(mkts) < 2:
            continue
        yes_sum = 0.0
        ev_vol = 0.0
        ev_liq = 0.0
        for mk in mkts:
            p = mk.get('outcomePrices', '[]')
            if isinstance(p, str):
                p = json.loads(p)
            if p:
                yes_sum = yes_sum + float(p[0])
            ev_vol = ev_vol + float(mk.get('volume', 0) or 0)
            ev_liq = ev_liq + float(mk.get('liquidityNum', 0) or 0)
        deviation = yes_sum - 1.0
        abs_dev = abs(deviation)
        # H-MI-2: both legs trade on Polymarket, so cost = 2x Poly taker + slippage.
        net_edge_internal = abs_dev - FEE_ROUNDTRIP_POLY_INTERNAL
        net_edge_pct_internal = round(net_edge_internal * 100, 2)
        if abs_dev > 0.05 and net_edge_internal >= 0.01:
            rows.append({
                'polymarket_question': ev.get('title', ''),
                'polymarket_slug': ev.get('slug', ''),
                'polymarket_yes_price': round(yes_sum, 4),
                'polymarket_volume': ev_vol,
                'polymarket_liquidity': ev_liq,
                'predictit_question': '',
                'predictit_yes_price': None,
                'predictit_best_yes': None,
                'predictit_best_no': None,
                'price_divergence': round(deviation, 4),
                'abs_divergence': round(abs_dev, 4),
                'divergence_pct': round(abs_dev * 100, 2),
                'fee_roundtrip_pct': round(FEE_ROUNDTRIP_POLY_INTERNAL * 100, 2),
                'net_edge_pct': net_edge_pct_internal,
                'match_similarity': 1.0,
                'suggested_action': 'Internal multi-outcome deviation detected',
                'source_comparison': 'polymarket_internal_multioutcome',
                '_epoch': now_epoch,
            })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
if not df.empty:
    df = df.sort_values('net_edge_pct', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
